Default: **10 pitches per channel per rolling 7 days**"  |  21.02-pitching-outreach-cx.md:46-47 — "It does not apply to 21.02.01 (the DSP's own form has its own one-shot rule) and applies weakly to 21.02.04 (radio pitching is low-volume and relationship-gated by nature)."  |  21.02-pitching-outreach-cx.md:87 — "| R-02 | 21.02.06 Rate Limits | 21.02.01 DSP Editorial Pitch | No interaction. findings.forcedInvention: The implementer must invent (a) whether the DSP editorial path consumes or is gated by any WeJammin budget at all, and (b) a numeric meaning for 'weakly' on the radio channel — a full 10-per-7-days budget as 21.02.06 states, some smaller cap, or none. Both are enforcement-surface decisions on the feature the domain calls 'the domain's immune system'.

findings.forcedInvention: N — the post-payment survival window that gates escrow release and therefore decides when a creator is actually paid. The observation-path question (Q-03) settles how the check is made, not how long the obligation runs.

findings.claim: The smart link's core fan-facing behaviour is specified two ways with no marker: DT-03 makes silent redirect on a remembered preference the default, while the landing page's own Populated render state describes a chooser with the remembered service listed first, and no Decision in the file records either.
findings.evidence: 21.04.01-smart-link-builder.md:103 — DT-03: "⚠️ CONFIRMED WITH A GUARD, not wholesale. Silent redirect on a remembered preference is the right default — it honours D-03 ... The behaviour: redirect on remembered preference, but always land through a page that offers a visible \"not your service? / other options\" escape within the first interaction — never a redirect the fan cannot get back from."  |  21.04.01-smart-link-builder.md:94 — "| Populated | Destinations resolved | Remembered service surfaced first, then the plausible options, then the full list — the honest routing hierarchy |"  |  21.04.01-smart-link-builder.md:33-34 — "Routing is by the listener's revealed or remembered preference. The honest hierarchy is: remember what they chose last time, then offer the plausible options, then let them pick."  |  21.04.01-smart-link-builder.md:118-121 — D-01 to D-04 record destination derivation, no-capture, remembered-beats-inference and rot surfacing; none records the redirect-vs-chooser behaviour
findings.forcedInvention: Whether the page auto-advances a returning fan to their remembered DSP (with an escape affordance) or renders a chooser with that service first. The file calls this surface 'the most latency-sensitive surface in the domain' (:61, :93), so the two builds differ materially in the metric the feature is judged on, and DT-03's own '⚠️ CONFIRMED WITH A GUARD' outcome was never promoted into a Decision that the States table could be reconciled against.
